data.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany or Hungary
data.description:
About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be the engineer who gets Linro running inside a customer's real environment and keeps it running. Our founders and go-to-market team win the customer and own the commercial relationship. You own the technical side: you take a customer from signed agreement to a working install and the first blocked change, and stay on it after go-live for upgrades, incidents and tuning. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota.

What you will do

  • Run customer onboarding end to end: connect the customer's cloud accounts, whichever provider they run on, deploy sensors (managed, or inside the customer's own cluster) and get to a first blocked change fast.

  • Write and tune SQL-based policies and policy packs mapped to each customer's frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA), and keep false positives low.

  • Wire Linro guardrails into the customer's Terraform and CI/CD workflows and into their AI coding agents through MCP.

  • Run Linro in production at the customer: monitor, upgrade and respond when it breaks. Debug inside their environment, hand reproducible findings to engineering, and fix what you can yourself.

  • Close the loop: structured feedback to product and engineering, reusable playbooks for the next customer, and a seat in scoping calls so that what we promise is what installs.


What we are looking for

  • 5 to 6+ years of customer-facing technical delivery (forward deployed or solutions engineering, SRE or platform consulting), deploying infrastructure or security software in customer environments and keeping it running afterwards.

  • Hands-on cloud experience: you have run real workloads, identity and access, networking and audit logging on at least one major cloud, and you pick up the others quickly.

  • You are a solid engineer. You write real code in Go or Python for integrations and tooling, read Go services, and are comfortable with SQL and APIs.

  • You use AI coding agents daily, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and have hands-on MCP experience.

  • You understand how companies work: change management, approvals, release and audit processes, and how to fit Linro into them.

  • Restricted-network experience: proxies, private networking, data residency, self-hosted or in-cluster installs.

  • Communication and comfort with ambiguity. You explain trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives, set honest expectations, and keep making progress when requirements are still unclear. Fluent English.

  • Open to travel. To customers across Europe and the US, up to roughly a quarter of your time.

Nice to have

  • Turning compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) into concrete controls.

  • Policy-as-code (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Cedar) or CSPM tooling.

How we work

We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. You own every customer deployment from day one, with direct access to the founders and to the engineers who built what you are deploying.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other's time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. You will often be the first person to run Linro in a customer's environment, and you will write the playbooks as you go. If you want a polished onboarding process and a stable product surface, this is not it. If you want to sit between a new category and the customers who need it, and you like the idea of deploying the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

Compensation: €60K – €110K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Professional (T4) • €60K – €82K • Offers Equity
  • Senior (T5) • €85K – €110K • Offers Equity

data.description:
About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be one of our first infrastructure hires, taking day-to-day operation of the platform off the CTO. Linro enforces policy on other people's cloud infrastructure, so our own has to be reliable, reproducible and auditable. You own production: how Linro runs for each customer, how it upgrades, and how we know it is unhealthy before a customer does.

What you will do

  • Own production reliability: SLOs, alerting, on-call and blameless postmortems for the control plane and every customer installation.

  • Make the install fleet boring: provisioning, maintenance windows and safe auto-upgrades across SaaS and self-hosted installs.

  • Fix the open reliability work: sensor memory ceilings and OOM visibility, ClickHouse cost and capacity, and the health of Postgres, PGMQ and Temporal.

  • Evolve the platform: Terraform and Terragrunt, Helm, GitHub Actions with short-lived OIDC credentials, local development (Tilt, Coder), and staging and production environments, with guardrails for humans and AI agents alike.

  • Produce audit-ready operations: backups, disaster recovery and continuity tests with evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on operation of AWS, GCP or Azure in production, AWS preferred. Not just deploying to it, actually running it: accounts and access management, networking and the failure modes. We run across several clouds, so you pick up the others quickly.

  • 3+ years running production Kubernetes with Helm, including debugging OOMs, resource limits and failed rollouts.

  • Terraform in multi-environment setups, with CI/CD in GitHub Actions and short-lived credentials.

  • Go, or Python and a wish to learn Go. You read and write code in the services you operate.

  • Observability and SLOs: symptom-based alerting with Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry, and the discipline to delete noisy alerts.

  • Production Postgres: backups, point-in-time recovery, migrations and upgrades.

  • Incident ownership: on-call, leading incidents and writing postmortems that change something.

  • Security-minded operations: least privilege, secrets handling, access reviews and audit trails.

  • You work with AI agents every day, including for infrastructure changes, and know where to trust them and where to check their output.

Nice to have

  • Operating Temporal, queues or ClickHouse, including cost tuning.

  • Shipping and upgrading software in customer-run or self-hosted environments.

  • Compliance operations: SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS evidence.

  • Using AI coding agents safely for infrastructure work.

  • Early-stage startup experience, or having been a founding infrastructure engineer.

How we work

We work remotely across Europe. On-call is part of this role. We will be open about how the rotation works and compensate it. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. You own production and the platform underneath it, with direct contact with the engineers and a say in how we build.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other's time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. Our infrastructure is defined as code, but parts of it are still being moved into CI, runbooks are thin, and some environments are rougher than others. You would inherit something that works, not something polished. If you want a mature platform team with a clear roadmap for the next two years, this is not it. If you want to build the operational backbone of a security product from close to the start, and you like the idea of running the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

Compensation: €75K – €93K • Offers Equity

You would be our first dedicated product manager, working closely with the founders and the engineering team. You decide what we build next and in which order, across the whole product, and you ground those decisions in regular conversations with customers, from the first discovery call to the roadmap review. Clear priorities are the heart of this role: with a small team, picking the few things that matter most is what moves the product forward.

What you will do

  • Talk to customers and prospects yourself (CISOs, security and platform leads): run discovery calls, demo what exists, take the objections and turn feedback into a clear, ordered roadmap.

  • Own priorities and the backlog: keep one ranked list across the whole product and the tools around it, decide what gets built next and what does not using explicit criteria (customer pain, pilot and revenue impact, compliance relevance, engineering cost), and re-rank it with the founders every cycle. Write the PRDs and decision memos engineers build from, and check what ships against what you promised.

  • Translate what customers need into clear requirements for engineers, including how our guardrails should behave when the user is an AI coding agent: tool design, failure modes, and what an agent may change on its own.

  • Own releases end to end: plan them with engineering, define what done means, write clear release notes and make sure customers understand what changed and why.

  • Be the product voice in front of customers: join sales and buyer calls, present the roadmap and handle security and compliance questions (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI). Set success metrics and launch criteria.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years as a product manager (or a founder or engineer who moved into product) on B2B infrastructure, security or developer products sold to enterprises.

  • Technical fluency. You can read a Terraform plan, you have a solid grasp of databases and SQL, you understand APIs at least at a high level, and you hold your own with engineers on trade-offs.

  • Hands-on customer discovery. Customer interviews and pilots you ran yourself, and a record of turning that into a few sharp bets instead of a long list.

  • Prioritization and written clarity. A record of ranking competing demands with a small engineering team, using explicit criteria, and of explaining those trade-offs clearly to customers and founders. Specs and decision memos that stand on their own.

  • You know the buyer: CISOs and platform leads. You are comfortable in front of customers and executives: you can run a discovery call, a demo or a roadmap session on your own and earn the room. You can map features to compliance frameworks at product level, not auditor level.

  • You use AI tools daily for research, synthesis and prototyping, and have a point of view on designing for LLM agents as users.

Nice to have

  • Policy-as-code (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Cedar), or time at a CSPM, IaC or CI/CD vendor.

  • Zero-to-one product work at an early-stage startup.

How we work

We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write decisions down, and protect people's focus time. We use AI coding agents ourselves, so specs need to be precise enough for a person or an agent to build from.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. You are the first product hire, with direct contact with users and a real say in what we build and what we refuse to build.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market (range above).

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other's time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. You would build the product function from scratch: the roadmap process, the analytics and the way we decide are yours to shape. The founders care a lot about the product, and they want a partner who pushes back and sharpens the calls with them. Some of what you decide early will change as we learn. If you want a mature product organisation with clear processes, this is not it. If you want to define a product and a category from close to the start, and you like the idea of owning the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be our dedicated quality engineer, working with the engineering team. Linro runs across many plugins and integrations, and at its core a policy engine decides whether a cloud change is compliant. If it decides wrong, a customer either ships a change that fails their audit or gets blocked for no good reason. You build and own the process that proves it all works: the test strategy, an automated regression suite for the core engine and every plugin and integration, and the quality gates between AI-written code and production. Automation first, manual testing where it makes more sense.

What you will do

  • Own the test strategy and the regression platform: nightly, pre-release and production runs against live installs, with reporting people trust and a clear line between environment noise and real regressions. We use Playwright today; the tooling is your call as long as it works and is easy to operate.

  • Own the correctness of the policy engine: build a reference set of test cases with known expected results, plus property-based and differential tests, so policies evaluate the same way across past, present and simulated future state.

  • Run the test environments: real sandbox cloud accounts, cloud emulators, capacity and cost per environment.

  • Own the CI quality gates in GitHub Actions, and review the tests and changes our AI coding agents produce.

  • Extend coverage across the web frontend (components and user flows), the plugins and integrations, the MCP server and the guardrails agents call, including basic security testing.

What we are looking for

  • 4+ years in test or quality engineering for distributed backend or cloud products. You write and review real code. We use Go and TypeScript, but any language works.

  • You use AI coding agents daily and have a view on how tests become the control layer when agents write the code.

  • Strong written, async communication and the judgement to call a failure a product bug, a test bug or environment noise.

  • End-to-end testing, built and operated. You know how end-to-end tests really work across UI, APIs and the infrastructure underneath, and you have run them as pipelines yourself: nightly and pre-release runs against live environments, test data and environment setup, flaky-test handling and reporting that people trust. Playwright or similar tooling.

  • API, integration and frontend testing: gRPC or ConnectRPC services and the databases behind them, plus component and UI tests for a TypeScript web frontend.

  • A strategy for correctness-critical logic: golden files, property-based and differential testing, and a habit of asking what a false "compliant" would cost.

  • Hands-on cloud, Terraform and Kubernetes with Helm, including ephemeral environments and keeping cloud cost in check.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Cloud control-plane or IAM knowledge, or a security testing background.

  • Experience testing MCP servers or LLM-agent flows (non-deterministic evals).

How we work

We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. What we offer

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

The honest version

This is early. Our regression platform is real but still being rebuilt: some environments are noisy, some tests are parked, and some coverage does not exist yet. data.title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
data.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

  • Lead hardware-aware quantum error-correction studies and guide architectural decisions for future processor generations.

  • Coordinate realistic performance models connecting hardware characterization, circuit-level noise models, and logical performance metrics.

  • Work closely with System Architecture, System Operations, Software Engineering, and Quantum Applications teams to support the co-design of future fault-tolerant quantum computers.

  • Contribute to the development and mentoring of a growing fault-tolerance team while supporting eleQtron’s long-term technology roadmap.


Required Skills:

  • PhD in Physics, Quantum Information and Computation, or a closely related field.

  • Exceptional postdoctoral or industrial research experience in quantum error correction and, ideally, logical architecture design.

  • Demonstrated scientific leadership and the ability to drive independent research activities.

  • Ability to work effectively across theory, hardware, software, and engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent communication in English 

What you can expect from eleQtron: 

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements. 

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules. 

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game. 

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development. 

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being.  

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus.  

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications. 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices, and meeting rooms.

data.title: Senior Sales Manager Global Markets (all genders)
data.description:
Your tasks

Do you want to win international brands for Remazing, lead complex sales cycles, and actively shape our global commercial strategy? Then this role could be the perfect fit for you.

As Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic opportunities, high-stakes pitches, and long-term client relationships across multiple markets. The position also offers a path towards becoming Sales Lead for Remazing Core and taking on functional and people leadership for our Sales team, which currently consists of two team members.

Your tasks

GLOBAL NEW BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT: You will identify and develop strategically relevant business opportunities across our international markets and own the entire sales process, from targeted outreach and qualification to negotiation and contract signature. You will build a robust global pipeline and develop sustainable partnerships with relevant brands.

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT: You will manage complex opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, build relationships with senior decision-makers, and position Remazing as a strategic partner. You quickly understand business challenges and translate them into compelling, value-led solutions.

PITCH OWNERSHIP & NEGOTIATION: You will own international pitches and complex tenders, develop analysis-driven narratives together with internal teams, and lead negotiations confidently through to closing. You will ensure that our proposals are commercially compelling and tailored to the relevant brand, market, and need.

COMMERCIAL STRATEGY & MARKET DEVELOPMENT: You will analyse market and industry trends, identify new target segments, and translate them into concrete growth opportunities. You will actively contribute your insights to the development of our global commercial strategy, service portfolio, and go-to-market approaches.

SALES OPERATIONS & FORECASTING: You will manage your pipeline based on data, maintain accurate deal progression in HubSpot, and prepare reliable forecasts. You will challenge processes and metrics, define concrete actions, and create transparency around priorities, risks, and potential.

INTERNATIONAL COLLABORATION: You will coordinate cross-market opportunities and work closely with our international hubs as well as Consulting, Marketing, and other specialist teams. You will create clear ownership, connect different perspectives, and ensure consistent communication with prospective clients.

TEAM DEVELOPMENT & MENTORING: You will share your expertise, support colleagues in challenging sales situations, and provide structured feedback. Even before taking on formal leadership, you will strengthen shared standards, improve ways of working, and support the team in its day-to-day business.

LEADERSHIP PERSPECTIVE: You will have the opportunity to develop towards the Sales Lead role for Remazing Core. data.description:
Dein Team


Das Data & Automation Team ist Teil der OMR Tech Abteilung und fungiert als Center of Excellence für die Daten- und Prozessoptimierung bei OMR. Wir schaffen die Basis für fundierte, datengetriebene Entscheidungen und reibungslose Abläufe in allen Business Units (Festival, Podstars, Reviews, Education, Jobs). Wir verstehen uns als starker Business Partner: Wir bauen die Brücken zwischen komplexen Datenstrukturen, smarter Automatisierung und echtem Business Impact.

Bock auf maximale Freiheiten in einem unternehmerischen Umfeld? Du liebst es, Datenpipelines zu bauen, die einfach laufen, und Infrastruktur, auf die sich alle verlassen können? Dann verstärke unser Team und übernimm die Verantwortung für das technische Fundament unserer Datenplattform. Bei uns betreibst du nicht nur Pipelines: Du baust die Dateninfrastruktur, auf der der gesamte OMR-Kosmos seine Entscheidungen trifft!


Wo du wirklich was bewegst


  • Du verantwortest unsere ELT-Pipeline-Infrastruktur, entwickelst, betreibst und überwachst unsere Airflow-DAGs auf Cloud Composer und managst unsere Connector-Landschaft (Airbyte, Fivetran)
  • Du baust eigene Airflow-Operatoren für Datenquellen ohne Standard-Connector und bindest neue Quellen an unser Data Warehouse an (aktuell über 28 externe Systeme)
  • Du betreibst und optimierst unsere BigQuery-Infrastruktur von Performance-Tuning über Partitioning und Clustering, Monitoring der Query-Kosten und sauberes Schema-Management in der Raw Zone
  • Du behandelst unsere Datenpipelines wie Produktivsysteme und machst sie standardmäßig beobachtbar: Du konzipierst Monitoring und Alerting rund um Pipeline-Health, Source Freshness, Datenqualität und operative SLAs – so, dass wir wissen, was kaputt ist, warum und wen es betrifft, bevor die Business Units es merken
  • Du entwickelst unsere CI/CD-Pipelines (GitHub Actions) für Ingestion und dbt weiter und bringst dich aktiv in Code Reviews ein
  • Du gestaltest unseren Stack aktiv mit: Du legst das infrastrukturelle Fundament für unsere strategischen Datenprojekte, etwa den Aufbau unserer zentralen Audience-Datenplattform, und triffst wichtige Entscheidungen zu Architektur und Tooling mit
  • Du bringst AI in die Datenplattform: Von AI-gestütztem Troubleshooting und automatisierter Pipeline-Diagnose über intelligente Data-Quality-Checks bis zu Dokumentation, operativen Workflows und Developer Tooling experimentierst du mit Agents und Automatisierung, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren. Du kannst zu unserem unternehmensweiten AI-Agenten beitragen und entscheidest mit, wo AI echten Mehrwert schafft – und wo klassisches Engineering die bessere Lösung bleibt

  • Du kennst dich mit BigQuery aus (Performance, Kosten, Berechtigungen) und bringst GCP-Grundlagen mit (IAM, Cloud Storage, idealerweise Workload Identity Federation)
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits mit dbt, Fivetran oder Airbyte gearbeitet und kennst Tools wie Docker, Terraform oder Cloud Monitoring
  • Du handelst eigeninitiativ, arbeitest strukturiert und hast Lust, die volle Verantwortung für eine geschäftskritische Infrastruktur zu übernehmen

data.title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
data.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.


Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben.

data.title: SAP Solution Architect / SAP Lösungsarchitekt / Inhouse in Hannover (gn)
data.description:
Einleitung

Wie viele SAP-Einführungen hat man im Berufsleben, bei denen man das Design verantwortet, statt es umzusetzen?


Bei den meisten: keine. Das Design kommt vom Beratungshaus, intern wird getestet und abgenommen. Hier ist es umgekehrt. Das Beratungshaus setzt um und Du entwirfst.


Das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant ist ein global tätiges Industrieunternehmen mit rund 15 Standorten weltweit, das sein komplettes ERP-Umfeld auf SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud umstellt. Nicht als Lift and Shift, sondern als Gelegenheit, die weltweiten Geschäftsprozesse neu zu denken und in einem System abzubilden. Worum geht es

Fachbereiche formulieren Anforderungen. Was sie tatsächlich brauchen, steht selten darin. Die Differenz zwischen beidem zu erkennen und in ein Design zu übersetzen, das Implementierungspartner ohne Rückfragen bauen können, ist der Kern dieser Rolle. Du bist das technische Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und externen Partnern, mit der IT im Rücken. Nicht als Moderation, sondern als Instanz, die entscheidet, wie ein Prozess im System aussehen wird.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest das Solution Design für die Einführung des neuen globalen ERP-Systems auf S/4HANA Private Cloud.
  • Du analysierst und bewertest komplexe Anforderungen der Fachbereiche daraufhin, wie sie im System abgebildet werden, und unterscheidest dabei zwischen dem, was gefordert wird, und dem, was gebraucht wird.

  • Du steuerst externe Dienstleister, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse und stellst die Umsetzung sicher.


Dein Profil

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon drei in ERP-Beratung oder ERP-Projekten.

Benefits

  • Internationale Wirkung über rund 15 Standorte hinweg.

data.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect // Prozesse und Toolchain (gn) // hybrid
data.description:
Einleitung

Enterprise Solution Architect (gn)
Schwerpunkt Prozesse und Toolchain

Wie oft bekommt man die Aufgabe, Enterprise Architecture in einem Konzern nicht zu zeichnen, sondern zum Laufen zu bringen?

Architekturen entwerfen viele. Dafür sorgen, dass sie gepflegt werden, dass das Tool mit den Quellsystemen spricht und dass die Prozesse dahinter von Menschen tatsächlich befolgt werden, das können wenige. Diese Rolle ist genau dafür da. Du bist die Person, die EAM in einem Konzern vom Konzept zur täglichen Praxis macht.

Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die IT wird gerade organisatorisch neu aufgestellt, und das Enterprise Architecture Management im Zentralbereich bekommt dabei eine eigene Rolle für das, was sonst nebenbei laufen soll und deshalb nie läuft: Methodik und Werkzeuge. Was es gibt: eine Architekturfunktion, Boards und Communities, Quellsysteme mit Daten. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht, das sich selbst trägt.

Worum es geht 
Du verantwortest die methodische und technische Grundlage des EAM. Prozesse, die so gestaltet sind, dass sie effizient bleiben. Eine Toolchain, die ihre Daten aus den Quellsystemen automatisch bezieht. Eine Datenqualität, die man messen kann. Und Nutzende, die wissen, was sie tun. Das ist eine seltene Aufgabe, weil sie selten als eigene Stelle existiert. Wer sie übernimmt, bestimmt, ob Architekturarbeit im Konzern eine Disziplin ist oder eine Absichtserklärung.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst das Prozessframework für EAM: Prozessmodelle und RACI-Matrizen bis hin zu Anforderungskatalogen.
  • Du führst Tool-Evaluierungen über RFI- und RFP-Prozesse durch, implementierst und konfigurierst die EAM-Toolchain und konzipierst Datenimport und Integration mit CMDB, ITSM und Cloud-Plattformen.
  • Du evaluierst neue EAM-Methoden wie Wardley Mapping oder Business Capability Heatmaps und entscheidest, was in den Konzern passt.
  • Du führst regelmäßige Prozessreviews durch, planst und setzt Tool-Updates und Funktionserweiterungen um und passt das Architektur-Metamodell an veränderte Anforderungen an.
  • Du misst die EAM-Prozessreife kontinuierlich gegen Industriestandards und Best Practices.
  • Du stellst Verfügbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit der EAM-Tools sicher und verantwortest Rollen- und Zugriffskonzepte.
  • Du definierst KPIs für Datenqualität und prüfst Vollständigkeit, Aktualität und Konsistenz.
  • Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Konzepte für alle Tool-Nutzenden, pflegst die Anwenderdokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in IT-Architektur, insbesondere Solution- oder Enterprise-Architektur, gern mit technischer Leitungsverantwortung
  • Praxis in Planung und Steuerung bestehender und zukünftiger IT-Landschaften
  • Erfahrung in Einführung und Administration eines führenden EAM-Tools, etwa LeanIX, Ardoq, Mega HOPEX, Sparx EA oder ADOIT
  • Sichere Anwendung gängiger EAM-Frameworks wie TOGAF, ArchiMate oder Zachman, idealerweise zertifiziert
  • Erfahrung mit internen EAM-Boards oder Architektur-Communities
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im IT-Umfeld

data.title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
data.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.

About the Role

As co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.a

Your remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow.

Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works.

What you’ll do

You will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it.

  • Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response.

  • Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops.

  • Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services.

  • Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision.

  • Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface.

  • Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard.

  • Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in.

  • Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship.

  • Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations.

About You

You have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well.

We are looking for depth in five areas:

  • Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped.

  • Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself.

  • LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics.

  • Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them.

  • Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality.

You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • A strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users.

  • Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments.

  • Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH.

  • Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges.

Why Join

With the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create.

The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows.

We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it.

This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

data.title: People & Culture Director/HR Director (f/m/d)
data.description:
Tion investiert in Infrastruktur im Bereich der Energiewende, um den Übergang zu einer Zukunft sauberer Energie voranzutreiben. Mit einem 167 MW Portfolio aus Wind- und Solarparks, einer Batteriespeicheranlage, unserer Beteiligung an der clearvise AG sowie unserem vorrangigen Zugang zu einer Pipeline von mehr als 5 GW, arbeiten wir darauf hin, eine führende Plattform für Investitionen in Projekte innerhalb der Energiewende zu werden.

Unterstützt von EQT*, einer zweckorientierten globalen Investmentgesellschaft mit nordischer Herkunft, profitiert Tion von EQTs weitreichender Erfahrung im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien und dem Zugang zu einem Netzwerk von über 600 Industrieberatern sowie interner Expertise in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeit und Digitalisierung.

Mit gesicherter Projektpipeline und Funding konzentrieren wir uns nun darauf, unser Team herausragender Personen aufzubauen, um Tion zu skalieren. Besuche uns unter www.tion-renewables.com oder vernetze dich mit uns auf LinkedIn, um uns besser kennenzulernen. Lies gerne weiter, um mehr darüber zu erfahren, was wir in einem People & Culture Director suchen.

Als Arbeitgeber bieten wir:

  • Ein unternehmerisches und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, das kontinuierliche berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung fördert

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Arbeitsrechts

  • Ausgeprägte Leidenschaft und Motivation, langfristig mitzuwirken und zu gestaltensowie eine unternehmerische und leistungsorientierte Einstellung

data.title: Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Werde Teil unseres Teams

Die Energiewende braucht Ware, die ankommt.

  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Regelmäßige Company-Events und Freizeitangebote im Büro bieten Gelegenheit, auch abseits der Arbeit zusammenzukommen. 
  • Ausstattung und Einstieg: Moderne Hardware für Office und Homeoffice sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze unterstützen dich im Arbeitsalltag. Bei einem strukturierten Onboarding vor Ort in München lernst du Memodo kennen.


Das erwartet dich

  • Operative Wiederbeschaffung in deinem Produktbereich: tägliche und wöchentliche Bestellroutine, Bestellauslösung, Kontrolle der Auftragsbestätigungen und Terminverfolgung.
  • Steuerung der Bestellreichweiten sowie frühzeitige Warnung bei Verfügbarkeits- und Engpassrisiken.
  • Operative Lieferantenkommunikation im Tagesgeschäft – von Terminen und Mengen bis zur sachlichen Vorbereitung von Reklamationen.
  • Engpass-Management: strukturierte Eskalation an Hersteller und Erarbeitung von Allokationsvorschlägen gemeinsam mit Strategischem Einkauf und Product Management.
  • Abstimmung der Anlieferungen mit unserer Logistik und Lagerleitung, auch bei Teil- und Unterlieferungen.
  • Datenbasiertes Arbeiten mit unseren Beschaffungs- und Analyse-Tools, inkl. Rückmeldung von Fehlern an die IT.
  • Saubere Dokumentation und Ticket-Disziplin als Basis für eine verlässliche Vertretung im Team.
  • Strukturierte Inputs an Strategischen Einkauf, Product Management und S&OP zu Verfügbarkeit, Liefertreue und Engpassmustern.


Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management, in der Disposition, Materialplanung oder Beschaffung, idealerweise in einem breiten, internationalen oder saisonalen Sortiment.
  • Strukturierte, verlässliche und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise - systematisch statt reaktiv.
  • Hohe Zahlen- und Datenaffinität sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und Excel.

  • Zusätzliche Erfahrungen im internationalen Speditions- und Logistikumfeld sind von Vorteil.

Dabei begleitest Du unsere Kunden von der strategischen Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und leistest einen aktiven Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung moderner Verwaltungsleistungen.

Anforderungen verstehen – Lösungen entwickeln: Du erfasst, strukturierst und bewertest fachliche Anforderungen aus komplexen Verwaltungs- und Sozialversicherungskontexten. Aus regulatorischen, organisatorischen und fachlichen Vorgaben entwickelst Du praxisnahe Konzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Entwicklungsteams zusammen und begleitest die Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in digitale Lösungen.   • Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams im Rahmen der Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen 
  • Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen und fachlicher Netzwerke 
  • Eigenständige Weiterentwicklung fachlicher und strategischer Themen 
  • Bereitschaft zu Reisen sowie zu Einsätzen vor Ort bei Kunden und Partnerdienstleistern  
  • Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in deutscher Sprache  

    Wünschenswert:

  • Projekterfahrung im Umfeld der Sozialversicherung, öffentlicher Auftraggeber oder vergleichbarer regulierter Organisationen  
  • Verständnis für Abläufe und Strukturen in der Sozialversicherung oder öffentlichen Verwaltung  
  • Kenntnisse in ECM/DMS sowie idealerweise in FOM und OM  
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Verbänden, Trägerorganisationen oder institutionellen Stakeholdern ist von Vorteil  


Warum wir?

data.title: Division Director arveo services (m/w/d)
data.description:

arveo ist die mit dem German Innovation Award 2025 ausgezeichnete Content-Services-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, aus Dokumenten echtes Wissen zu generieren. Cloud-nativ, hochskalierbar und mit über 300 Schnittstellen – etwa zu Microsoft 365 und SAP – nahtlos integrierbar, ist arveo die Basis für die intelligente, datengetriebene Organisation von morgen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau unserer Division arveo services suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und inspirierende Führungspersönlichkeit, die Marktchancen erkennt, Menschen begeistert und gemeinsam mit ihrem Team die Zukunft von arveo services gestaltet.

  2. Personal- und Fachführung der Heads of Business Unit 
  3. Personalverantwortung für Sales / Business Development 
  4. Steuerung der Geschäftsfeldentwicklung der Division

  • Vision schaffen: Du übernimmst die strategische und wirtschaftliche Verantwortung für die Division arveo services und entwickelst einen klaren Zukunftskurs für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Geschäfts. Dabei analysierst und bewertest Du Markttrends, erkennst neue Potenziale und übersetzt Chancen in eine überzeugende Vision und nachhaltige Wachstumsstrategie.

data.title: Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d)
data.description:
About us

IGES GmbH specialises in health economic and strategic research and consulting services for international pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers. It offers biotech, pharmaceutical and medical device companies solutions for market access, pricing and reimbursement of their medical innovations. The company has offices in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom and also provides support for multinational product launches. IGES is part of the Athagoras Group, which brings together various consulting firms for the life sciences industry.

To strengthen our team in the area of Value Strategy & RWE, we are looking for a Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d)


Your mission

  • Design, execution, evaluation and interpretation of analyses based on claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or registry data – from data preparation through cohort definition to the presentation of results 
  • Interpretation and contextualisation of analysis results to generate robust real-world evidence, and its translation into strategic recommendations for our clients
  • Strategic consulting for market access, HE&OR and RWE departments at leading pharmaceutical companies and emerging biotechs
  • Providing technical oversight and quality assurance for analyses in interdisciplinary projects, as well as mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Providing support on HTA-related issues (e.g. evidence requirements, PICO scoping, analysis strategies) and translating the results into publications, presentations and project reports
  • Conducting systematic literature reviews and structured evaluations to supplement findings from claims data
  • Active involvement in the further development of internal data and methodological expertise for analyses of health data from the FDZ-Gesundheit
  • Collaboration on the preparation and publication of results, e.g. in scientific journals, project reports and presentations of findings


Your profile

  • Successfully completed degree (master's/diploma) in health services research, public health, health economics, statistics, epidemiology or a comparable field 
  • Several years’ relevant professional experience in the analysis of claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or register data – in an industrial or academic environment
  • Demonstrable ability to interpret analysis results independently, synthesise them into real-world evidence and present them in a manner tailored to the target audience
  • Proficiency in epidemiological and statistical methods, to the extent required for the practical evaluation of claims data
  • Experience in drafting scientific documents, e.g. study protocols, study reports or publications
  • Programming skills in R or Python would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of HTA/market access requirements is welcome but not essential
  • Analytical thinking, structured and careful working style, and a high degree of initiative
  • Open-minded and communicative personality with a team- and client-oriented approach
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (academic level)


Our offer

  • Collaboration on varied projects involving highly innovative drugs at the interface of healthcare research, real-world evidence and strategic consulting
  • An interdisciplinary, collegial working environment with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths and good development prospects
  • Professional and personal development through challenging project work, plenty of scope for your own ideas and individually tailored further training (e.g. conferences)
  • Gain practical experience in using large claims data sets, as well as early development of expertise relating to the FDZ Gesundheit
  • Flexible working arrangements after structured training at the Berlin site, including the option to work from home
  • A Permanent position with competitive remuneration, flexible working hours, 30 days of holiday and additional time off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve

data.title: Content Creator, Personal Brand (50-100%)
data.description:
About Fortisana and Leon

Muscle means quality of life. We’re building the brand your parents will love.

At Fortisana, we believe muscle is an overlooked foundation of independence: the strength to keep doing tomorrow what matters to you today. Our mission is to bring muscle maintenance into everyday conversation, across generations.

Our first product is a science-based, all-in-one daily drink built around essential amino acids, creatine, a vegan collagen-building complex and electrolytes. Light and refreshing, it makes a daily nutrition routine easy to stick with. The formula was developed with longevity researcher David Church.

Behind Fortisana are Leon, Piran and Max. Together, we combine the experience of founding KoRo (>240m revenue) and 25 yeas of experience in the supplement history from Leon's family business. We’re bringing that experience to a brand built around strength, independence and quality of life.

You’ll work directly with Leon, one of Fortisana’s founders and a nutritionist who grew up in the supplement industry. His personal content brings together nutrition, sport and the experience of building a company.

Role description

You own the development and day-to-day production of Leon’s personal social channels. Your job is to turn his knowledge, experiences and point of view into content that feels recognisably his and gives people a reason to keep watching.

You are his creative partner: finding the story in a conversation, asking the follow-up question and spotting moments worth capturing. You take content from idea to finished edit and publication, with regular access to Leon for conversations and filming.

You're full of determination to hone content creation as a newer craft and start with a 100% internship or you're deeper into the game and work part-time or freelance (minimum 50%).

What you’ll do

  • Develop the channel direction, content pillars, recurring formats and publishing calendar with Leon.

  • Interview him regularly to uncover stories, opinions, lessons and explanations grounded in his own experience.

  • Write hooks, scripts and captions that preserve his voice and work naturally on camera.

  • Plan and film direct-to-camera videos, interviews and behind-the-scenes content; accompany him at selected relevant activities and events.

  • Edit finished short-form videos, including audio, subtitles and supporting visuals, and adapt material for the agreed platforms.

  • Publish content, engage with the audience and use questions and performance data to improve future pieces.

  • Coordinate specialist freelancers when needed and work with Leon and relevant reviewers to keep factual statements accurate.

What you bring

  • A portfolio of compelling social videos, ideally including personality-led content, interviews or a channel you have helped grow.

  • Strong interviewing and storytelling instincts: you can help someone express a clear, interesting point of view.

  • Confident filming and editing skills, including practical knowledge of lighting and sound.

  • Strong short-form writing and an ability to capture someone else’s voice.

  • The judgment to make health and nutrition topics accessible without overstating the evidence.

  • Initiative, organisation and comfort working closely with a founder, both on set and in everyday situations.

  • Fluent in English, with particularly strong writing skills. German is a plus.

  • Availability to work full-time, on-site in Zurich or Berlin, with regular in-person filming with Leon.

  • Experience in health, nutrition, sport or entrepreneurship is a plus. Experience handling sensitive or unpublished material thoughtfully is valuable.

Why this role

  • Work directly with Leon and get close to the industry. Leon grew up in a family business with more than 25 years of supplement experience and brings deep industry relationships. You’ll learn through the conversations, decisions and stories behind his work, with direct access to him for ideas and feedback.

  • Learn how experienced founders build again. Alongside Leon, you’ll work with the Fortisana team, including Piran, who helped build KoRo into one of Germany’s leading food brands. You’ll see how they apply that experience to building a new company from the ground up.

  • Shape a voice people want to follow. You’ll have the creative freedom to develop original formats, ask better questions and turn Leon’s knowledge and experiences into compelling stories. Your work will shape his personal brand as Fortisana pursues its ambition to become a major consumer brand.

  • Develop quickly through real creative work. Build your interviewing, writing, filming and editing skills through regular production and close feedback. You’ll create a portfolio that shows both your craft and your ability to bring someone’s personality to life.

How to apply

Send three pieces of work you’re proud of and explain exactly what your part was: concept, interviewing, script, filming, editing or publishing. We’re particularly interested in examples where you brought out someone’s personality or turned a conversation into a strong story. Add your location, availability and a short profile or CV.

data.title: Social Media Content Creator Intern
data.description:
Über Fortisana

Muskeln bedeuten Lebensqualität. Wir bauen die Marke, auf die unsere Eltern gewartet haben.

Wir glauben, dass Muskeln das unterschätzte Fundament unserer Unabhängigkeit sind: die Kraft, morgen noch das zu tun, was uns heute wichtig ist. Unsere Mission ist es, das Thema Muskelerhalt generationsübergreifend ins Bewusstsein zu rücken.

Unser erstes Produkt ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink mit essentiellen Aminosäuren, Kreatin, einem veganen Kollagen-Aufbau-Komplex und Elektrolyten. Leicht, erfrischend und einfach in den Alltag einzubauen. Die Rezeptur wurde gemeinsam mit dem Longevity-Forscher Professor David Church entwickelt.

Hinter Fortisana stehen Leon, Piran und Max. Wir verbinden tief verwurzelte Erfahrung in der Supplementbranche mit dem Wissen aus dem Aufbau von KoRo (240m Jahresumsatz) und Leon's Familienunternehmen, das seit 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel produziert. Gemeinsam bauen wir eine Marke rund um Kraft, Unabhängigkeit und Lebensqualität.

Deine Rolle

Du gestaltest den organischen Social-Media-Auftritt von Fortisana — von der ersten Idee bis zum veröffentlichten Beitrag. Du beantwortest echte Kundenfragen, zeigst unser Produkt im Alltag und entwickelst Inhalte, die Menschen ansehen, speichern und teilen möchten.

Dabei setzt du selbst um: Du entwickelst Konzepte, stehst hinter der Kamera und schneidest fertige Videos. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, das dir Orientierung und regelmäßiges Feedback gibt. Wenn ein Projekt zusätzliche Expertise braucht, koordinierst du spezialisierte Freelancer.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam entwickelst du die inhaltliche Ausrichtung, wiederkehrende Formate und den Redaktionsplan für unsere organischen Social-Media-Kanäle.

  • Du verbindest Trendformate und Fragen aus der Community mit Produktwissen und relevanter Forschung in Geschichten.

  • Du planst und organisierst Drehs mit Gründern, Teammitgliedern, Kund:innen und weiteren Mitwirkenden.

  • Du filmst und schneidest Kurzvideos: von Produktdemonstrationen und Erklärvideos bis zu Interviews und Einblicken hinter die Kulissen — inklusive Ton, Untertiteln und einfachen Grafiken.

  • Du erstellst ergänzende Stories und Carousels und entwickelst einen wiedererkennbaren visuellen Stil mit.

  • Du veröffentlichst Beiträge, trittst mit der Community in Austausch und machst aus wiederkehrenden Fragen neue Content-Ideen.

  • Du wertest aus, was Menschen zum Weiterschauen, Reagieren und Klicken bewegt, und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse für die nächsten Inhalte.

Was du mitbringst

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Social Content und Arbeitsproben, die zeigen, was du selbst umgesetzt hast — gerne auch für einen eigenen Kanal oder ein persönliches Projekt.

  • Ein gutes Gespür für Geschichten: Du verstehst, warum Menschen beim Scrollen stehen bleiben und weiterschauen.

  • Sicherheit beim Filmen und Schneiden sowie praktische Kenntnisse in Licht und Ton.

  • Freude am Schreiben von Hooks, Skripten und Captions.

  • Ein gutes Auge für Bildgestaltung, Typografie und einfache Social-Media-Layouts.

  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich zu erklären und dabei inhaltlich präzise zu bleiben.

  • Eigeninitiative und Organisationstalent, um Drehs, Feedback und Veröffentlichungen im Blick zu behalten.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch, insbesondere ein sehr gutes schriftliches Ausdrucksvermögen auf Deutsch.

  • Zeit für ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeitpraktikum vor Ort in Zürich oder Berlin.

  • Erfahrung mit Ernährung, Gesundheit, Lifestyle oder E-Commerce ist ein Plus.

  • Kenntnisse in Motion Graphics und Sounddesign sind ebenfalls ein Plus.

Warum dieses Praktikum?

  • Lerne von Gründern, die bereits große Marken aufgebaut haben. Piran hat KoRo zu einer der führenden Food-Marken Deutschlands mit aufgebaut. Leon und sein Familienunternehmen produzieren seit mehr als 25 Jahren Supplements. Du arbeitest direkt mit uns und erlebst, wie daraus Entscheidungen über Produkte, Marke und Wachstum entstehen.

  • Bekomme echten kreativen Freiraum. Schlage ein Format vor, teste einen neuen Hook, plane einen Dreh und setze deine Idee um. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam - und vom Markt.

  • Learning by Doing. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung in Storytelling, Dreh, Schnitt und Community-Aufbau. Dabei entsteht ein Portfolio, das deine Handschrift trägt, und du lernst aus nächster Nähe, wie eine Konsumgütermarke aufgebaut wird.

  • Schaffe dir eine Perspektive im Team. Nach einem erfolgreichen sechsmonatigen Praktikum besteht die Möglichkeit, in eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei Fortisana übernommen zu werden, mit Equity-Beteiligung.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns drei Arbeiten, auf die du stolz bist, und beschreibe genau, was dein Beitrag war: Idee, Skript, Dreh, Schnitt oder Veröffentlichung. Wenn vorhanden, ergänze Ergebnisse und was du daraus gelernt hast. Dazu reichen dein Standort, dein möglicher Starttermin und ein kurzes Profil oder Lebenslauf.
