data.title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
data.description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.


What you'll own

Define the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.


    What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust 

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design 

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills


    • Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.


    Hiring Process
    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
     
    First Stage 
    Portfolio & Design Leadership 
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage 
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership 
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage 
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact 
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

    Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX
    OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

data.title: Foward Deployed AI Engineer (m/d/w)
data.description:
KI-Systeme bauen, integrieren und beim Mittelstand zum Laufen bringen.

Du baust KI-Systeme, die wirklich laufen – RAG-Pipelines, Agenten, Automatisierungen. Und Du willst nicht im Backlog eines Produktteams verschwinden, sondern direkt beim Kunden sehen, was deine Lösung bewirkt.

Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bei Neurawork bist Du die technische Instanz in unseren Kundenprojekten im Mittelstand: Du verstehst die Prozesse des Kunden, entwirfst die Architektur, integrierst unsere Standardprodukte tief in seine Systemlandschaft und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende etwas produktiv läuft – nicht nur auf Folien existiert. Weil Du technisch weißt, wovon du sprichst, berätst du Kunden auf Augenhöhe – bis in die Geschäftsführung.

Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Wir setzen auf standardisierte Produkte als Hebel und passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert – und stehen dafür ein.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns machst

  • Technische Umsetzung beim Kunden: Architektur, Integration und Inbetriebnahme von KI-Lösungen (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Automatisierung) in bestehende Systemlandschaften – Cloud oder lokal

  • Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Use Cases auf Umsetzbarkeit, Datenlage, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Kunden-IT: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit, Betrieb

  • Beratung mit technischer Substanz: Kunden von der Fachabteilung bis zur Geschäftsführung fundiert beraten – Roadmaps, die technisch tragen

  • Mitgestaltung unserer Frameworks und Produkte: Erkenntnisse aus Projekten zurückspielen

  • Wissenstransfer: Live-Sessions aus laufenden Projekten in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit anschließendem TÜV-SÜD Zertifikat und im KI- Business-Coaching

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Framework-driven statt ad hoc – und du gestaltest die Frameworks mit

  • Standardprodukte als Hebel, Anpassungen bis zur Full-Integration selbstverständlich

  • Wert statt Stunden – Ergebnisse statt Tagessätze

  • Direkter Draht zum Founding-Team, keine Beratungspyramide

  • Präsenz online wie offline; GF Christoph Knöll ist sichtbar in der DACH-KI-Szene (data:unplugged, TÜV SÜD, LinkedIn)

Qualifikationen

Was wir suchen

  • Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften) oder einen vergleichbar tiefen technischen Werdegang

  • Selbst gebaute KI-Systeme: Du hast mindestens ein KI-System selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt – z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung

  • Tiefes technisches Verständnis von LLMs, Retrieval, Agentic AI, Cloud vs. lokalem Betrieb – inklusive der Grenzen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Code (z. B. Python), APIs und Datenanbindung

  • 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in technischer Umsetzung (z. B. als Engineer, Data Scientist, Entwickler:in, technische:r Projektleiter:in); Kundenkontakt oder Beratungserfahrung ist ein Plus

  • Freude daran, Technik verständlich zu erklären – idealerweise Erfahrung mit Workshops, Vorträgen oder Live-Sessions

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Nicht passend für dich, wenn …

  • Du eine Zertifizierung ohne Track Record hast,

  • Du lieber Strategien entwickelst, als selbst Hand an Systeme zu legen,

  • Du noch kein KI-System selbst gebaut hast, das Du zeigen kannst.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Mandatsverantwortung ab dem ersten Projekt, ohne Layer über dir

  • Fachlicher Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland - in unserem Team bist du immer am Zahn der Zeit

  • Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zur Vertestung

  • Sichtbarkeit als Experte über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation

  • Voll-remote möglich— Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2-4 Tage/Monat im DACH-Raum

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Marktgerechtes Gehalt bei schnellen Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit!

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und bring uns Dein Projekt mit!

Beschriebe uns in 3–5 Sätzen das KI-Projekt, das du uns im Zweitgespräch gerne zeigen würdest: Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast du selbst umgesetzt? Ein Link zu GitHub, Demo-Video o. Ä. ist willkommen.

  • Beruflich, privat oder Open Source – alles zählt, solange du es selbst umgesetzt hast.

  • Vertrauliche Kundenprojekte gern anonymisiert oder mit Beispieldaten

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich und Dein Projekt kennenzulernen!

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

  • Solid backend engineering fundamentals in Go, with experience shipping and maintaining production services.

data.title: Head of Talent, GTM
data.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

Omnea is scaling fast after our Series B, and Sales hiring is one of the biggest levers on our growth. We're looking for a Head of GTM Recruitment to own how we hire across Sales.

You'll lead a team of recruiters across the UK and US, while still running your own searches. Your focus starts in the UK and EMEA, and grows with us as global roles open up.

This is a 50/50 player-coach role. Half your time goes on building the team, the playbook and the partnerships with Sales leadership. The other half goes on doing the work: mapping, outreach, screening and closing the most senior and critical hires yourself.

We're building a very different kind of talent function, focused on quality and care over volume and speed. You'll set the standard for what that looks like.

What can you expect?

Lead the team

  • You'll lead, coach and grow a team of recruiters across London and New York, setting clear goals and holding a high bar on quality.

  • You'll hire into your own team as hiring scales, deciding where we need recruiters, sourcers or coordinators.

  • You'll take the time to differentiate the UK and US hiring engines to reflect local challenges and optimisation.

Build the engine

  • You'll own the hiring plan with sales leadership, forecasting headcount, prioritising roles and keeping us on target.

  • You'll build the Sales hiring playbook: role specs, success profiles, interview stages, scorecards and closing approach.

  • You'll own the numbers. Pipeline health, conversion by stage, time to hire, offer acceptance and quality of hire, reported to leadership and used to make decisions.

  • You'll raise the interviewing bar by training interviewers, calibrating scorecards and pushing back when the bar slips.

  • You'll get the most out of our tooling and AI so the team spends its time on candidates, not admin.

  • You'll prepare the function for global hiring as we open roles in new markets.

Hire the best

  • You'll personally run the most senior and critical sales searches, from mapping to close.

  • You'll be a trusted partner to our sales leaders, shaping role specs and challenging hiring decisions with data.

  • You'll craft outreach like a great salesperson and close top candidates against strong competing offers.

  • You'll build Omnea's reputation in the GTM talent market: invite-only events, investor networks, and becoming the go-to person for exceptional sales hires.

About you

  • You've got 8+ years in recruitment, with a strong GTM focus in high-growth startups or agencies placing into them. At least 2 of those years were spent leading recruiters.

  • You've built or scaled a GTM hiring function before, ideally across more than one country. You know what great looks like in Sales and you can spot it fast.

  • You're still a brilliant recruiter. You love being on the tools and you'll happily own a senior search while coaching your team through theirs.

  • You run the function on data. You know your funnel, you spot problems early, and you use numbers to change minds.

  • You hold your own with senior commercial leaders. You can push back on a spec, challenge a hiring decision and earn their trust.

  • You've got a strong network in the European GTM and startup ecosystem.

  • You're a ruthless prioritiser, highly organised and outcomes-focused. You use AI across your work and you never let the basics slip on process, comms and ATS hygiene.

  • You're entrepreneurial. You want to build something, not run something that already exists.

  • And you're a really good human: collaborative, kind and low-ego. You raise the bar for the people around you.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

data.title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
data.description:
Job Description

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

 

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings.

  • Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet.

  • Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support.

  • Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews.

 

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

data.title: Social Content Producer
data.description:
Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

Role Overview

The Social Content Producer is a hands-on creative role, focused on the day-to-day ideation, capture, editing, and delivery of Healf’s social content. This person operates at the intersection of creative vision and production execution, fluent in both conceptualisation and hands-on craft. This person is a natural storyteller with a genuine passion for social media and wellbeing, demonstrated through a portfolio of engaging, attractive, and story-rich content, Reporting into the Head of Content, the Social Content Producer is responsible for creating engaging, original, and wellbeing-obsessed content to life that is on-brand, platform-ready, and sets Healf’s socials apart. As a key player in bringing content to life, the Social Content Producer will collaborate with wider comms and partnership teams to bring a range of concepts to life.

What You Will Do:

  • Ideate, capture, and edit social-first content including short-form video, photography, motion graphics, and static assets for owned social channels, primarily Instagram.

  • Optimise content for saves, shares, and reach, constantly pushing for creative assets that drive engagement.

  • Drive ownable formats forward, working with talent to create unmistakably Healf series.

  • Edit final assets using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and other tools within the Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Bring Healf’s product curation to life in creative, social formats that go beyond aesthetic UGC.

  • Interpret creative briefs and brand guidelines to produce content that is visually consistent and strategically aligned.

  • Contribute to the overall social media strategy and help shape it through original, scroll-stopping ideas.

  • Assist in pre-production planning, specifically shot list development.

  • Support in managing content calendars, asset libraries, and production logistics.

  • Stay on the pulse of social media trends, emerging formats, and platform algorithm changes to inform content strategy.

  • Work closely with brand and talent partners to bring a range of content to life, including product-first concepts and talent campaigns.

  • Stay in the know of wellbeing trends, brand innovation, and cultural moments.

  • Actively contribute creative ideas in brainstorms and concept development sessions.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines without compromising quality.

  • Work with influencers, content partners, and other talent to bring social-first concepts to life.

  • Support paid social by adapting and repurposing top-performing organic content into ad-ready formats.

  • Collaborate with the paid social/performance team to ensure creative learnings and platform trends inform both the organic and paid content pipelines.

What You Will Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in social content production, digital media, or a related creative role.

  • Proficient in Final Cut Pro and Adobe Photoshop; strong command of Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, and Lightroom.

  • Deep understanding of social content best practices and what makes content successful across specific platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate strategic briefs into premium, on-brand visual content.

  • Strong visual storytelling sensibility and a keen eye for design, motion, and editorial quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfortable presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.

  • Strong project management instincts with the ability to prioritise across multiple workstreams.

  • The ability to translate the brand’s tone of voice, mission, and visual identity through original social concepts.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Putting Healf in front of new audiences through bold, innovative, and culturally resonant ideas that interrupt mindless scrolling.

  • Consistent contribution to weekly content performance, tracked against reach, saves, shares, and comments across organic social.

  • Delivery of content within agreed timelines and briefs, supporting a repeatable production cadence.

  • Growth in content quality and originality, reflected in improved all-time performance ranking over time.

  • Creating organic content that transitions seamlessly into paid use.

  • Elevate Healf as the leading wellbeing brand, owning the intersection of wellbeing and culture, while maintaining a consistent social voice.

The Deal

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.

We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.

If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

data.title: Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer
data.description:
Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer

Location: Budapest, Hungary

Ways of working: Hybrid
Contract: Permanent, full-time

About Hawk-Eye Innovations

Hawk-Eye Innovations is at the forefront of sports technology, delivering officiating, tracking, broadcast and performance solutions across some of the world's biggest sports. As part of Sony Sports, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation, helping athletes, coaches, teams, broadcasters and governing bodies make better decisions through technology.

Bring computer vision to the world of sport

What if athletes, coaches and teams could access the kind of tracking technology that has traditionally been out of reach?

We’re building a new generation of tracking services for elite and semi-professional sport, putting powerful computer vision technology directly into the hands of the people who need it most.

We’re looking for a Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer to help make that possible.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building products at the cutting edge of sport and technology. With the direction set and plenty still to be built, you’ll have the autonomy to shape solutions, make important technical decisions and see your work make a real difference.

The role

You’ll own computer vision on the device, taking detection and tracking models and making them work reliably on consumer Android phones and tablets.

That means much more than getting a model to run. You’ll optimise and profile inference for real-world hardware, balancing performance with accuracy across different devices, lighting conditions and environments. You’ll work close to the camera capture pipeline, where frame timing, exposure and device behaviour can all affect the quality of the output.

Your challenge is to ensure that the data produced on a mobile device is accurate, reliable and trusted by the wider tracking system.

You’ll work closely with mobile, backend, computer vision and machine learning engineers, with the freedom to own both your technical approach and its implementation. We also embrace AI-augmented and AI-delegated development as part of how we work, enabling a small team to build and iterate at pace.

This is an opportunity to solve genuinely challenging engineering problems, influence how on-device vision is built and help establish the foundations for a technology that can change how sport is experienced and analysed.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own on-device inference: Design and implement Android inference solutions that meet demanding accuracy, latency and performance requirements.

  • Build the native Android vision layer: Develop and maintain C++ components using the Android NDK, alongside JNI bindings that connect them to our Kotlin application.

  • Optimise models for mobile: Convert, quantise, profile and optimise detection and tracking models, exploring techniques such as pruning, graph optimisation and operator-level improvements.

  • Solve real-world camera challenges: Work close to the capture pipeline, understanding how frame timing, exposure and camera behaviour influence model performance.

  • Make accuracy measurable: Build validation tools and measurement processes that demonstrate performance against ground truth in real-world conditions.

  • Engineer for real devices: Account for thermal constraints, battery consumption, hardware differences and the unpredictable conditions encountered in the field.

  • Collaborate on model improvements: Work with our computer vision and machine learning specialists to identify, prototype and evaluate improvements to model performance.

  • Shape technical decisions: Help determine what should run on-device and what should run elsewhere, bringing clear reasoning and an understanding of technical trade-offs.

  • Build production-quality software: Write maintainable, testable and reliable code that meets the team's engineering standards.

  • Work across disciplines: Communicate clearly with mobile application, backend and machine learning engineers who depend on your work.

  • Build with AI: Use AI-assisted and delegated development tools as a standard part of your workflow, working within our security and intellectual property guidelines.

As the team grows, there may also be opportunities to mentor other engineers, take technical leadership of on-device vision and establish the standards and practices that shape our approach to edge AI.

What you’ll bring

You’re an experienced computer vision or machine learning engineer who enjoys taking algorithms beyond the lab and making them work reliably in production.

You’re comfortable working close to the hardware, investigating problems that don’t show up in controlled environments and making informed trade-offs between accuracy, performance and resource consumption. You can work independently, communicate your thinking clearly and collaborate with engineers across different disciplines.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • At least 4 years of applied computer vision or machine learning engineering experience, including solutions deployed into production.

  • Demonstrable experience running inference on Android or embedded devices, rather than working exclusively with desktop or server hardware.

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • A strong interest in learning new technologies, tools and platforms.

Experience in automotive, embedded systems or other resource-constrained environments could be particularly relevant.

Technical skills

You’ll have expert-level knowledge of:

  • Applied computer vision, including object detection, tracking, camera geometry and the challenges that arise outside controlled environments.

  • Mobile or embedded inference runtimes, including model conversion and quantisation toolchains.

  • Model optimisation and performance profiling for resource-constrained hardware.

  • C++, particularly the Android NDK and JNI.

  • Measuring and validating model accuracy against ground truth.

You’ll also be comfortable with:

  • Kotlin, with enough experience to work effectively across the JNI boundary.

  • Python for prototyping, tooling and data analysis.

  • Mobile camera capture pipelines, including frame timing and exposure control.

  • Machine learning fundamentals, allowing you to contribute meaningfully to discussions about model improvements.

  • Git, code reviews and continuous integration practices.

It would be beneficial to understand:

  • Real-time and latency-sensitive systems.

  • Spatial computing and multi-view reconstruction.

  • The Android application development and release lifecycle.

You don’t need to have worked with every technology listed. We’re interested in the depth of your engineering experience, your ability to solve difficult problems and your willingness to learn.

Our technology

Our stack includes C++, Android NDK, JNI, Kotlin, Python and AWS, supported by Git, GitHub Actions, Jira and Android mobile inference and profiling tools.

Why Hawk-Eye?

At Hawk-Eye, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology used across the world's leading sports while solving complex technical challenges alongside talented engineers and product teams. You'll play a key role in shaping products from the ground up, working in an environment that values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build cutting-edge mobile products that make a genuine impact in sport, we'd love to hear from you.

Hungary Benefits

  • Annual Leave: Standard according to local labour law

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model (2 days in our office per week)

  • Access to sporting events and tickets

  • Sony Group Company Discounts

  • Other Benefits: Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, Nursery & Kindergarten contributions, Annual MOL Bubi Pass), Private Medical Insurance, Life & Accident Insurance, MindentMent Dental Clinic discounts, Seniority Awards, Employee Assistance Program

Hawk-Eye Innovations is at the forefront of sports technology, delivering officiating, tracking, broadcast and performance solutions across some of the world's biggest sports. We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer to take ownership of the mobile application at the heart of this experience.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building something new, with the opportunity to shape the architecture, influence technical decisions and see your work make a tangible difference. We work with a high degree of autonomy and embrace AI-augmented development to help us build and iterate at pace.

The role

You’ll own the Android application from architecture and implementation through to release and ongoing reliability. It’s the part of the product that athletes, coaches and teams interact with directly - the application that captures data, coordinates devices, manages sessions and transfers information back to the wider system.

The challenge is making all of this work reliably in the real world.

Our products are often set up and operated by users who have never used them before. They may be working on unreliable internet connections, managing multiple devices and operating in environments we cannot control. That means intuitive setup, clear feedback, resilient data transfer and graceful recovery from failures are fundamental to the product, not features to add later.

You’ll work across the full Android stack, from camera capture and local storage to device-to-device communication, background processing and release management. You’ll also integrate native C++ components developed by our computer vision engineers, helping bring advanced tracking capabilities into a dependable mobile experience.

This is a role for an engineer who enjoys owning complex problems end to end, making thoughtful architectural decisions and building software that works beyond the ideal conditions of a development environment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the Android application: Lead the design, architecture and implementation of a production-ready mobile application, taking responsibility for quality, maintainability and performance.

  • Build the capture experience: Develop and maintain the camera and media capture layer, including camera configuration, session management, recording and local storage.

  • Coordinate connected devices: Build the mechanisms that allow multiple devices and on-site edge units to operate as a single system, including communication, setup, synchronisation, shared state and recovery when connections fail.

  • Make unreliable networks manageable: Design robust data and media transfer, with prioritisation, queuing, retries and partial-failure handling built into the application.

  • Integrate native components: Connect C++ computer vision components through the Android NDK and JNI, owning the Android application functionality and integration around them.

  • Own the release lifecycle: Manage releases across environments, including Google Play submissions, internal testing tracks, remote configuration and release signing.

  • Build for reliability in the field: Implement crash reporting, diagnostics and observability so that issues can be understood and resolved without someone needing to be physically present.

  • Design for real devices: Account for battery consumption, thermal behaviour, background execution restrictions, permissions and differences across Android versions and device types.

  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with backend, design and computer vision engineers, managing dependencies and ensuring the application integrates effectively with the wider system.

  • Maintain high engineering standards: Write testable, maintainable code that other engineers can understand, extend and confidently build upon.

  • Help the team deliver: Contribute to planning, estimation and task breakdown, identifying risks and dependencies early.

  • Build with AI: Use AI-assisted and delegated development tools as a standard part of your workflow, within our security and intellectual property guidelines.

As the team grows, there may also be opportunities to mentor other engineers, take technical leadership of mobile development and establish the standards and practices that shape the discipline.

What you’ll bring

You’re an experienced Android engineer who enjoys taking ownership of an application from the first architectural decisions through to production release.

You understand that great mobile engineering is about more than functionality. It’s about building an experience that remains reliable when devices behave differently, networks drop out and users encounter situations you couldn’t have anticipated.

You’re comfortable working independently, making sound technical decisions and collaborating with engineers outside your specialism. You take pride in delivering production-quality software and are motivated by solving practical problems that have a direct impact on users.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • At least 4 years of mobile application development experience, including substantial delivery of native Android applications using Kotlin.

  • A portfolio of applications shipped and available on Google Play.

  • Experience taking applications through the full development lifecycle, from project creation and architecture to release signing and store approval.

  • A degree in a software-related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • A willingness to learn new technologies, tools and platforms.

Technical skills

You’ll have expert-level knowledge of:

  • Native Android development using Kotlin.

  • Device-to-device communication and data serialisation, including technologies such as Wi-Fi Direct and Protocol Buffers.

  • Mobile camera and media systems, including capture pipelines, codecs and local storage management.

  • Building resilient applications for unreliable networks, including background transfers, queuing, retries and partial-failure handling.

You’ll also be comfortable with:

  • Mobile CI/CD and automated release pipelines.

  • Writing unit and integration tests.

  • Git, code management and code review practices.

  • Task and ticket management tools such as Jira.

  • Mobile application architecture and design.

  • Android device lifecycle constraints, including thermal behaviour, battery usage, background execution limits, permissions and differences across OS versions and device tiers.

  • Web service integration and API contracts.

It would be beneficial to understand:

  • Real-time and latency-sensitive data delivery.

  • Integrating native computer vision or machine learning components into an Android application.

  • Coordinating multiple devices as part of a single system.

  • Kotlin Multiplatform and its potential as a future route to iOS.

You don’t need to have worked with every technology listed. We’re interested in strong native Android fundamentals, sound engineering judgement and the ability to learn and solve unfamiliar problems.

Our technology

Our stack includes Kotlin, C++ using the Android NDK and JNI, Protocol Buffers, REST and WebSocket APIs, AWS, Git, GitHub Actions and Jira.

Why Hawk-Eye?

At Hawk-Eye, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology used across the world's leading sports while solving complex technical challenges alongside talented engineers and product teams. You'll play a key role in shaping products from the ground up, working in an environment that values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build cutting-edge mobile products that make a genuine impact in sport, we'd love to hear from you.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

  • Work with data engineering teams to secure pipelines, databases, warehouses, and cloud data services on AWS and GCP.

  • Own data and privacy controls for SC TRM and BNM RMiT, including assessments, evidence, remediation, and audit support.

  • Support privacy impact assessments, access reviews, monitoring, incident response, and privacy-by-design reviews.

What We Look For

  • 3+ years in data security, privacy engineering, security engineering, or data platform engineering.

  • Experience implementing and owning SC TRM and BNM RMiT controls relevant to data protection and technology risk.

  • Understanding of privacy-by-design, data classification, retention, access management, and third-party data sharing.

Language

data.title: Architect/Staff Embedded Software Engineer
data.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

As an Architect/Staff Embedded Software Engineers, you will be the foremost technical authority on hardware-software integration across the DX-1, spanning the ASIC, BMC, and high-speed interconnect fabric, from pre-silicon through post-silicon and into sustainment engineering.

We are looking for experienced Architect, Staff, and Principal-level engineers who will help shape OLIX's direction through systems thinking and deep technical expertise. You will partner closely with the Director of Software Engineering to define the technical direction of the organization, establish architectural standards, and make the critical technical decisions that determine how the hardware-software boundary is defined.

You bring exceptional depth across the full stack, the judgment to identify what matters most and why, and the ability to influence and align engineering teams without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable navigating complex technical tradeoffs, driving cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring that system architecture supports both current requirements and future scalability.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction for your team. Partner with the Engineering Manager to set technical direction within the team's scope, and take ownership of the architectural decisions that shape how the team builds and operates.

  • Translate priorities into execution. Work with the Engineering Manager to break down complex technical problems into concrete plans, and ensure the team is building the right things in the right way.

  • Hold the technical bar. Define the principles, interface contracts, and standards the team builds to — whether that's firmware interfaces, ASIC validation methodology, or interconnect fabric integration — and ensure they are applied consistently.

  • Make the hard calls in your domain. Own technical decision-making within your area: BSP and firmware architecture, ASIC validation methodology, BMC platform design, or interconnect fabric integration — depending on your focus.

  • Drive alignment within the team. Build shared understanding across engineers through rigour, clarity, and well-reasoned technical decisions. Collaborate with adjacent teams where your work has dependencies.

  • Own the full lifecycle within your domain. Lead technically across pre-silicon, post-silicon, and sustainment — from emulation and bring-up through to production reliability and field issue resolution.

  • Raise the level of the team. Support the growth of engineers around you — through code review, design feedback, and sharing technical judgment — as a senior individual contributor who holds the bar high.

Skills & Experience

data.title: Bioinformatics Software Engineer
data.description:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

We are seeking a Bioinformatics Software Engineer to drive the flow cytometry data engineering infrastructure, annotation pipelines, model registry operations, and code governance for an advanced clinical biomarker discovery platform operating under machine learning industry best practices and Medical Device Machine Learning (MedDev ML) standards.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating high-dimensional flow cytometry data into reproducible, production-grade features compliant with industry best practices and MedDev ML framework requirements. Your key deliverables will include frozen, reproducible feature pipelines and locked model registry artifacts. You will oversee automated cell-type annotation, manage model artifact registries, enforce data integrity, trace compliance, and handle leakage controls across machine learning partitions while leading peer code reviews.

Core Responsibilities

  • Flow Cytometry Data Engineering & Annotation Pipelines: Execute automated cell annotation workflows on large-scale cytometry datasets; generate cell membership files, cell subset ratio tables, and automated outlier quality-control (QC) reports. Apply locked automated gating ensembles across cross-validation and evaluation partitions, tracking and recording per-patient gating exposure metrics. Establish and lock baseline models and numerical stability criteria for flow cytometry feature extraction pipelines.

  • Model Registry & Governance: Manage the formal model lifecycle registry—versioning, freezing, and locking gating ensembles and candidate predictive models in adherence with industry best practices and MedDev ML regulatory frameworks. Refit shortlisted machine learning models on expanded cohorts and execute final model freezing prior to blinded clinical evaluations. Ensure full reproducibility by committing versioned code, pinning environment specifications (Conda/Docker), and logging all random seeds and model hyperparameters.

 

  • Code Quality, Review & Data Integrity: Serve as a primary code reviewer across the computational pipeline, enforcing strict data leakage controls, data integrity checks, and modular coding standards. Participate in Independent Method Reviews (IMRs), traceability audits, and regulatory compliance verification under industry best practices and MedDev ML guidelines while interfacing closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Bio-statisticians, and Clinical Scientists.

Team and Ways of Working

Embedded in a multidisciplinary team of 4 (ML Engineers, Biostatisticians, and Clinical Scientists) reporting directly to the Lead Data Scientist.

Qualification Requirements

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Statistics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of professional experience handling flow cytometry high-throughput data in regulated, academic, or biotech settings.

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Programming Mastery: Fluent in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch).

  • Software Engineering & Version Control: Proven experience with software engineering best practices: Git version control, CI/CD, workflow managers (Nextflow), environment pinning (Docker), and ML artifact tracking.

  • Cytometry Knowledge: Familiarity with flow cytometry feature generation and batch-effect harmonisation.

  • Familiarity with cross-validation leakage traps in high-dimensional flow cytometry predictive modeling.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

  • Experience working with clinical trial datasets, industry best practices, and MedDev ML regulations.

  • Experience in transplant immunology, oncology, or hematologic malignancies.

Key Competencies

Strong collaboration and communication skills, including documenting computational methods for regulatory audits and effectively communicating technical workflows to clinical scientists and cross-functional teams.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

  • Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

  • Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

  • Strong opportunities for career development and progression

data.description:
We are Vitesse – the treasury and payment partner of choice for insurance.

Your next adventure awaits!

Join the team who are redefining the payments space.

About Us

At Vitesse, we're more than just a payments platform – we're the trusted financial infrastructure connecting the global insurance ecosystem. Tailor-made for insurers, brokers, MGAs, and TPAs, our unified platform optimises claims funds, enables real-time global payments, and delivers full financial control. Our impact is real: over $20 billion in payments across 200+ countries, hundreds of millions returned to insurers’ balance sheets, and counting. We’re licensed in the UK (FCA), Europe (DNB), and New York (NYDFS), with over 260 amazing colleagues worldwide. With $93 million recently raised in Series C funding from KKR, our journey is just beginning, and our ambitions are sky-high.

Headquartered in the heart of London and expanding across Europe and the US, Vitesse is where your ideas power tomorrow’s insurance solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? You're in the right place.

THE CURRENT TEAM AND OUR MISSION

Customer Support at Vitesse is in the middle of a step change. We're moving from a reactive, ticket-led service to one that spots recurring problems, brings client insight into business decisions and helps improve the service at its source. We're investing in AI to handle routine contacts, so our team can spend their time understanding problems properly, speaking to clients directly and fixing root causes. You'll join a small team of six peers with tenure spread across our London and New York offices supporting insurers and their third-party administrators in the movement of claims funds. The work is varied, often urgent, and the clients depend on us getting it right.

You'll have real influence on how this function develops. You'll help train and improve our AI agent, spot the patterns behind client issues, and take the evidence to Product, Engineering and Customer Success. We want people who take ownership, aren't afraid to pick up the phone, and want to make Support a reason clients stay. Your ideas will be heard, and your impact will be visible.

About the Role

We’re building a Customer Support function that is a differentiator, not a ticket queue. Our service is personal and tailored to each client, and we’re investing in AI to handle routine contacts so our team can spend their time on the conversations that matter.

As a Customer Support Manager, you’ll take the time to understand each client’s problem, own it end to end, and pick up the phone when a call will resolve it faster than an email. You’ll work in a team of peers, collaborating with them and with Engineering, Product and Customer Success. You’ll also help train and improve our AI agent, and use what you see in support contacts to make recommendations that improve the business.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own complex client issues from first contact to resolution, communicating clearly and keeping clients informed throughout

  • Build client relationships through proactive outreach and calls, not only ticket replies

  • Carry out deeper technical triage and work with Engineering to prioritise issues and coordinate incidents

  • Draft clear, accurate incident updates for clients

  • Help train, monitor and improve our AI agent: review its performance, identify gaps, draft knowledge improvements and escalate them to the Customer Support Lead for approval

  • Spot recurring issues and themes, gather the data to support them, and escalate recommendations to Product, Engineering and Customer Success

  • Create and maintain high-quality knowledge base content and documentation

  • Analyse service quality trends and lead small improvement initiatives

  • Share knowledge and consult with peers to keep our service consistent and high quality

  • Run scenario-based sessions that help clients get the most from the platform

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3+ years’ experience in Customer Support, Client Services or a similar B2B customer-facing role

  • Proven examples of spotting a problem, evidencing it with data and escalating it, without being asked

  • Confident speaking with clients directly, including on calls, when issues are complex or sensitive

  • Experience handling escalations and complex queries

  • Experience working with technical or operational teams

  • Comfortable working with AI tools, with experience improving knowledge content

  • Experience with Zendesk or similar support tools is advantageous

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents or chatbots is desirable

  • Regulated sector experience (insurance, financial services) is advantageous but not essential

Skills & Attributes

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication

  • Takes ownership and sees problems through to resolution

data.title: Talent Acquisition Partner [12 month FTC]
data.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Talent Acquisition Teams

Wayve’s Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in our success. We hire the people who build and ship our autonomous driving technology. We’re a diverse team, based across the UK, US and Japan, and we take a sourcing first, quality focused and data-driven approach, acting as true partners to the business.

🧠 Your day-to-day

• Manage end-to-end recruitment for each role - sourcing, screening, interviewing and closing candidates, using Ashby to track your pipeline.

• Proactively source and headhunt candidates rather than relying on inbound applications, balancing depth of engagement for quality hires with the volume each search demands.

• Run regular check-ins and debriefs with hiring managers to keep every search on track.

• Deliver a world-class candidate experience through transparent communication, timely feedback and a seamless interview process.

• Track day-to-day metrics and flag pipeline bottlenecks as they come up.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

• Owning a portfolio of typically 10-15 concurrent roles spanning software engineering, machine learning, integration and data engineering through to product and program management.

• Educating hiring managers and stakeholders on job profiles and search strategy, so every search starts from a sharp, well-defined brief.

• Using data to make the right calls on where to focus search effort across your portfolio, and continuously improving how we hire based on what that data tells you.

• Advising hiring managers on how AI is changing the shape of technical and product roles, and helping translate that into hiring strategy and candidate profiles.

• Helping build the high-performing, diverse technical and product teams that drive Wayve’s innovation and business impact as the company scales.

🙌 You should apply if:

• You have 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruitment experience, in a fast-scaling tech startup or scale-up environment.

• You’re a sourcing-driven recruiter at heart. You proactively headhunt and engage candidates rather than waiting for applications to come to you, and you know how to balance sourcing for quality with adding volume into the funnel when the search calls for it.

• You’re highly data-driven, using pipeline data to diagnose bottlenecks, understand what’s working, and course-correct your search when things aren’t converting.

• You act as a true business partner to hiring managers, helping shape and define roles, not just taking orders.

• You’re forward-thinking about AI and how it’s changing roles and ways of working, and can advise hiring managers on how this shows up in the profiles they’re hiring for.

• You have hands-on experience using Ashby to manage your recruitment pipeline.

• Ideally, you’ve worked across both agency and in-house recruitment, giving you a well-rounded view of sourcing and candidate management.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call (45 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Sourcing; 30 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-function; 1.5 hours )

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (30 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Internal Product
Senior Fund Operations Manager
data.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

As we scale following our Series B, we are looking for a Senior Fund Operations Manager to play a key role in delivering exceptional fund operations and service quality to our customers. This is not a traditional fund administration role focused on repetitive processing.

We are looking for operators who deeply understand private markets operations, enjoy solving complexity, and want to help shape how modern fund administration should work.

You will work at the intersection of fund operations, client service, and product development - partnering closely with fund managers, investors, product teams, and internal operations functions to deliver a seamless experience across the full fund lifecycle. We are particularly looking for strong expertise in fund administration, transfer agency operations, fund onboarding, and complex post-close operational processes.

Your role

  • Act as a strategic operational partner to fund managers, supporting them across the day-to-day operations of their funds and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

  • Own and coordinate complex post-close operational processes, including capital calls, distributions, investor reporting cycles, and ongoing fund lifecycle events.

  • Lead operational execution for fund migrations and new fund launches, including the review, reconciliation, and migration of historical data from previous administrators.

  • Own capital call and distribution calculations end-to-end using our automated operational workflows, including the interpretation of LPA clauses, management fee calculations, equalisation mechanics, liquidity buffer assessments, and investor allocation logic.

  • Partner directly with fund managers to explain methodologies, align on assumptions and outputs, incorporate feedback where appropriate, and guide clients towards operationally and legally sound approaches based on fund documentation.

  • Partner with Fund Accounting to support recurring reporting cycles and ensure operational and financial data is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

  • Support treasury-related workflows, including payment coordination, invoice handling, and operational cash movement processes.

  • Act as a key point of contact for fund managers and investors, helping resolve operational queries with a high level of responsiveness and ownership.

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to shape and improve our internal platform and operational tooling based on real customer workflows and operational pain points.

  • Help drive the evolution of our “full back-office” operating model by identifying opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and scalable operational design.

  • Support, review, and mentor more junior team members, helping establish high standards for quality, operational rigour, and client service.

  • Improve processes, workflows, and documentation across the organisation to increase scalability, transparency, and operational excellence.

About you

  • You bring 4+ years of experience in fund administration, fund operations, transfer agency, or related private markets operations environments.

  • You have strong hands-on experience managing operational fund workflows across the full lifecycle, particularly capital activity, reporting processes, and complex operational coordination.

  • You understand private markets fund structures and are comfortable reviewing LPAs, investment agreements, and related fund documentation to identify operationally relevant terms and requirements.

  • You are highly detail-oriented and able to manage complex operational processes with accuracy and ownership under tight timelines.

  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally with other Fund Accounting, Product, and client-facing teams.

  • You bring a strong service mindset and understand how operational quality directly impacts customer trust and long-term relationships.

  • You enjoy improving systems and processes and are excited by the opportunity to help modernise fund administration through technology and AI.

  • You are proactive, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the operational quality bar across a team.

  • You are fluent in English; German is a plus.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and culture

  3. Case interview (45 min) + VP of Ops screen (30 min) – Collaborative problem-solving and communication skills

  4. Final Round (60 min) – Meet our Founders and senior stakeholders

  5. Reference calls to confirm your relationship building abilities

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.
