Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Au sein de l’équipe Fraude, tu contribueras à la lutte contre la fraude externe à l’échelle du Groupe, présent en France, en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et en Allemagne.
 
Tu auras pour mission d’innover en mettant l’IA et la data au service de la détection et de la prévention de la fraude, de piloter la fraude par la donnée et de construire la lutte contre la fraude sur nos nouveaux produits.
 
Tu évolueras dans une organisation tech et en croissance, où la data et la technologie sont au cœur des décisions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Data, Tech, Produit et les équipes anti-fraude locales.
 

Missions 🚀

1) Définir et faire évoluer le système de détection de fraude
    • Développer un dispositif antifraude efficace en collaboration avec les Business Units, les équipes Produit et Data, en t’inspirant des meilleures pratiques du marché
    • Concevoir des parcours modulaires adaptés au niveau de risque de fraude, en optimisant l’équilibre entre friction et prévention
    • Anticiper les risques de fraude liés au lancement des nouvelles offres bancaires et des programmes de cashback dès leur conception

2) Innover grâce à l’intelligence artificielle et à la veille technologique
    • Suivre l’évolution des menaces et des technologies de lutte contre la fraude, identifier les solutions les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations
    • Tester de nouvelles approches et piloter des POC
    • Concevoir et déployer, avec les équipes Data, Tech et Produit, des outils intelligents pour automatiser la détection et faciliter le travail des analystes

3) Piloter la performance et harmoniser les pratiques à l’échelle du Groupe
    • Construire et harmoniser les indicateurs de suivi de la fraude, développer les tableaux de bord et le reporting à destination du management
    • Analyser les tendances pour anticiper les risques et proposer des plans d’action
    • Travailler avec les équipes anti-fraude des différents pays pour partager les bonnes pratiques, contribuer à l’harmonisation des processus et suivre les évolutions réglementaires européennes et locales liées à la fraude

À propos de toi 👇

    • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce, master data, statistiques ou risques),
    • Tu justifies de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en lutte contre la fraude, gestion des risques, conformité ou data, idéalement en banque, cabinet de conseil ou fintech,
    • Tu maîtrises Excel et SQL, et tu as une bonne pratique des outils d’IA (machine learning, IA générative) et de data visualisation,
    • Tu connais bien les sujets de fraude au crédit et de  LCB-FT ; une expérience sur la fraude bancaire, aux moyens de paiement ou aux programmes de fidélité / cashback est un vrai plus,
    • Tu es curieux.se, tu as le goût de la veille et tu fais preuve de rigueur analytique,
    • Tu es autonome, de l’idée à la mise en production, et à l’aise dans un environnement international et transverse,
    • Tu parles anglais couramment, une autre langue européenne (italien, espagnol, portugais) constitue un atout.

Processus de recrutement 📅

    • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître et échanger autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min)
    • Deuxième entretien en visio avec Baptiste, Responsable Risque Opérationnel, pour revenir sur ton parcours et échanger sur ta vision de la fraude et de l’IA (30 min)
    • Étude de cas data et fraude à restituer à Baptiste suivie d’un échange avec tes futur.e.s collègues (90 min)
    • Entretien final en visio avec Romain, Group Chief Risk & Data Officer (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)
  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe
  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited
  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun
  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso
  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés
  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales
  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an
  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)
  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 
  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur
  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

data.title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
data.description:
Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.
  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Commercial terrain, Commercial itinérant, Sales, Freelance, Vente, Commercial B2B, Commercial indépendant, Développement commercial.

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

data.title: Head of Integrated Marketing France
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Integrated Marketing France pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing France, basée à Paris.

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Marketing France, vous piloterez l'une des trois équipes Marketing du marché français et managerez une équipe de 3 personnes.

Votre mission : être le point de connexion entre la stratégie Global et son exécution sur le marché France, en fédérant l'ensemble des parties prenantes autour d'une vision marketing claire, cadrée et exécutée dans les temps.

À la croisée de la stratégie, de l'orchestration et de l'exécution, vous porterez la vision marketing France auprès du Global et des instances exécutives locales, tout en veillant à ce que chaque campagne — globale ou locale — soit livrée avec excellence et dans les délais. Vous piloterez également le programme de fidélité en France.

Vos missions

  • Définir et porter la vision stratégique marketing France, en s'appuyant sur une compréhension fine de la stratégie Global et en assurant sa traduction pertinente sur le marché français (spécificités locales : créa, moments de consommation, culture...).
  • Être l'interlocuteur constructif du Global : savoir s'intégrer dans une stratégie globale tout en la challengeant de façon argumentée lorsque les spécificités françaises le nécessitent.
  • Fédérer l'ensemble des pôles (Sales, Brand & Media, Creative, CRM, Analytics, Global...) pour s'assurer que chacun travaille vers les mêmes objectifs et dans le même calendrier.
  • Piloter et sécuriser le calendrier de livraison des campagnes (globales et locales) : brief à temps, validation des plans média, validation brand, etc., pour garantir une exécution sans accroc.
  • Simplifier et cadrer des sujets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes, en faisant émerger les décisions à prendre et en portant les recommandations qui en découlent.
  • Formaliser et présenter la vision et la performance marketing France à un niveau exécutif, avec clarté et impact.
  • Piloter le programme de fidélité en France, en garantissant sa cohérence avec la stratégie marketing globale et les priorités business locales.
  • Intégrer l'IA dans les méthodes de travail de l'équipe, pour gagner en efficacité et en qualité d'exécution.
  • Manager et développer une équipe de 3 personnes, en apportant vision, coaching, structure et exigence d'exécution.

Le profil recherché

Vous êtes un(e) leader marketing structuré(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à simplifier des sujets complexes multi-stakeholders et à faire en sorte que les choses avancent.

Vous apportez notamment :

  • 8 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing, avec une expérience significative dans des environnements matriciels et multi-marchés.
  • Une capacité avérée à travailler à l'interface du Global et du Local, en sachant à la fois s'aligner sur une stratégie globale et la challenger de façon constructive quand nécessaire.
  • Un leadership naturel pour fédérer, cadrer et orchestrer des sujets impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes, sans lien hiérarchique direct sur la plupart d'entre elles.
  • Une forte capacité de formalisation et de communication, notamment pour porter une vision ou une recommandation devant un public exécutif.
  • Une orientation PMO marquée : rigueur, sens du détail, capacité à garder le contrôle sur des plannings complexes et à faire respecter les délais.
  • Une appétence pour l'IA et son intégration dans les méthodes de travail marketing.
  • Une expérience réussie en management et dans le développement de talents.
  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Les compétences qui feront votre réussite

  • Leadership et fédération d'équipes transverses
  • Simplification et cadrage de sujets complexes
  • Sens de l'organisation et rigueur (PMO)
  • Capacité à challenger de façon constructive
  • Communication et formalisation à niveau exécutif
  • Gestion de projet et respect des délais
  • Appétence pour l'IA et les nouveaux outils
  • Management et développement de talents
  • Connaissance du média (brand et performance)
  • Orientation business, à l'aise avec la data et le reporting chiffré

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

data.title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
data.description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

  • Experience with Hubspot

Soft Skills

  • You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships

  • You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs

  • You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone

Why join CrowdSec?

  • You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup

  • Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community

  • You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline

  • We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar.

data.title: Account Manager
data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry?

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.


That’s enough about us – what about you?

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

Position Summary:

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.


Key position responsibilities:

  • Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation

  • Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)

  • Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio

  • Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy

  • Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients

  • Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information

  • Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product

  • Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service

  • Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

  • Perform other special projects or duties when required


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Experience required:

  • Problem solving mindset

  • Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Good analytical skills with attention to detail

  • Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

data.title: Director of rewards, data & analytics
data.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system

You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers.

Your mandate has two sides:

  • Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable.

  • People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made.

What you'll do

Build and lead the hub

  • Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability.

  • Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team.

Own Total Rewards and compensation

  • Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning.

  • Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes.

  • Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE)

  • Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal.

  • Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity.

Turn People data into decisions

  • Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards.

  • Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions.

Shape benefits and international mobility

  • Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally.

Keep it trustworthy

  • Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle.

  • A track record of running people cost and headcount planning with Finance, and of building or rebuilding an HR data or analytics capability.

  • Multi-country practice across Europe and at least one of the US or APAC, with working knowledge of pay transparency and pay equity requirements.

  • Credibility with a CEO, a CFO and an Executive Committee: you bring fact-based recommendations and challenge constructively.

  • Sound judgement balancing fairness, business needs, market competitiveness and financial sustainability.

  • A builder mindset: you enjoy shaping a hub that is still taking form with a lean team, and you stay close enough to the detail to guarantee quality.

  • The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

  • Fluent English (our working language).

     

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

data.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in France.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.

As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.

data.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive II to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of Public Sector enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex deals with multiple stakeholders, and you'll have the support of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close. Camunda’s capabilities are well-aligned to the use cases that will help the DACH Administration digitize and automate for more efficiency and agility - this is an opportunity to shape and build a large and meaningful business!

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies Land opportunities and Expand possibilities, leveraging your extended resources such as Partners, Marketing, Inside Sales, Customer Success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to business and technical buyers, tailoring the message to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Handle tender processes with precision, observe pipeline health with discipline, manage Forecast with accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in DACH, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Efficient balance between driving towards a customer vision and achieving short-term projects towards this horizon.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with own initiative. The playbook will not provide all answers in advance!

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, orchestrating resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you, and you're learning to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • Experience navigating complex public procurement procedures - knowing and following the processes but also influencing them with initiative and creativity.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, particularly in a Public Sector context, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

  • Across complex multi-site programs, you bring together business functions, IT, Quality, sites, vendors, and system integrators, providing clear direction to project teams throughout demanding and critical phases.
  • Functional projects and workstreams covering process optimization and harmonization, solution design, system integration, data flows, and data migration are managed with confidence, while validation activities can also be supported conceptually at both program and project level.
  • With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions.
  • Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders.


Your profile

  • Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions.
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident.
  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. We offer full flexibility with flexible working hours, remote work options, and even the chance to work temporarily from abroad.
 
With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work.
 
Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.
 
We support your well-being with a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership and exclusive perks through our Corporate Benefits platform. You can also privately use your company IT equipment, and stay mobile with flexible options like JobRad, a company car, or a BahnCard. And because we value your network, we reward successful referrals with an attractive bonus.
 
We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst produktive Softwarelösungen, die Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren, Daten nutzbar machen und Mitarbeitende im Alltag unterstützen. Dabei kombinierst Du fundiertes Software Engineering mit modernen KI-Technologien, um skalierbare Anwendungen mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Fachbereiche zu entwickeln:

  • Entwicklung produktionsreifer Software-, AI- und Automatisierungslösungen – von der Idee bis zum Go-Live
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung intelligenter Anwendungen, AI-Agenten und Assistenzsysteme auf Basis moderner LLM-Technologien
  • Entwicklung robuster Backend-Services, APIs und Frontends zur Integration interner und externer Systeme
  • Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung sinnvoller Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen
Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht an isolierten Proof-of-Concepts oder reinen Experimenten, sondern an produktiven Anwendungen, die täglich von Mitarbeitenden genutzt werden und einen direkten Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg leisten. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf professioneller Softwareentwicklung. KI-Technologien sind dabei ein Werkzeug, um innovative und skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Typescript sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme und Datenquellen
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Technologien wie OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Frameworks
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von RAG-Systemen, Embeddings, Vektor-Datenbanken und semantischer Suche
  • Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, Testing sowie im Einsatz von Docker und Cloud-Technologien
    Erfahrung im Aufbau produktiver Softwarelösungen über Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts hinaus
  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen
  • Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
Das wäre ein Plus 
  • Erfahrung mit Machine Learning über die Nutzung von LLMs hinaus (z. B. Modelltraining, Klassifikation oder Forecasting)
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot Studio oder der Power Platform
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM-, PIM- oder E-Commerce-Systemen (insbesondere SAP)
  • Erfahrung mit Process Automation und Workflow-Orchestrierung
Das zeichnet dich aus 
  • Du entwickelst gerne Lösungen, die produktiv eingesetzt werden und echten Mehrwert schaffen
  • Du möchtest nicht nur AI-Tools nutzen, sondern intelligente Systeme entwickeln und weiterdenken
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und Digitalisierung
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und bringst eigene Ideen ein


Das erwartet dich

  • Die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz von KI bei einem internationalen Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Spannende Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Unternehmensprozesse und Entscheidungen
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein motiviertes und erfolgreiches Team, das offen zusammenarbeitet und Wissen teilt
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem modernen und multikulturellen Umfeld
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine Unternehmenskultur, die Eigeninitiative fördert
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Hybrid- und Remote-Möglichkeiten
  • Exklusive Vorteile wie Hansefit, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Getränkeversorgung, frisches Obst und Essenszuschuss


Wann es für dich los geht

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen.

Bitte sende uns Deinen Lebenslauf sowie Links zu GitHub-Projekten, technischen Referenzen oder eigenen Softwareprojekten. Wir möchten sehen, was Du bereits entwickelt hast und wie Du technische Herausforderungen löst.

data.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

  • Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

  • Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months

  • Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

  • Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

  • By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

  • Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

data.title: Backend & Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data.

📝 Your Role

In a nutshell

You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability.

You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory.

Your impact

  • Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months.

  • Reduce production blind spots by improving incident detection and follow-through.

  • Evolve the architecture to better support concurrency, parallelism and processing volumes.

  • Help the team deliver AI components that are reliable, performant and properly integrated into the product.

Your day-to-day work

  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs in Python.

  • Work with the rest of the team, to deliver product changes end to end.

  • Measure and improve processing time, scalability and backend architecture.

  • Strengthen testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

  • Collaborate with, the Applied AI Engineer, particularly on pull-request reviews and the backend integration of AI-enabled features.

✨ Your Team

You will work closely with:

  • Ivan Panico — Lead ML Engineer and your manager, who will support your ramp-up and major architectural decisions.

  • Tom — Applied AI Engineer, who owns the main Applied AI topics and partners with you on product integration.

  • Armand — Full Stack Developer, your main partner for designing and delivering product features end to end.

The team is mainly based in Paris and works remotely from France.

  • Understand latency, throughput, concurrency, parallelism and resource-consumption challenges.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • Open and direct communication.

  • An analytical mindset and the habit of testing your assumptions.

  • A collaborative approach across backend, frontend, product and applied AI.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Built up to two years of professional experience, through employment or significant projects in Python backend development.
